name: ema_crossover_momentum_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, when the 1-minute EMA (12 bars at 5s) crosses above the 3-minute EMA (36 bars at 5s), it marks the moment short-term institutional buying has overtaken the recent medium-term trend average — the characteristic microstructure footprint of FII/DII TWAP algorithms that are 40-60% through a directional order. These algorithms execute over 2-5 minute windows, so the 1-min vs 3-min EMA cross fires roughly at the midpoint of the order flow burst, leaving another 60-90 seconds of residual momentum before the order completes. The ADX(36) filter (>20 at 3-min scale) ensures the cross occurs while NIFTY is in a directed microstructure rather than the oscillatory, bid-ask-bouncing regime that generates false crosses, and VWAP alignment confirms the broader intraday institutional bias.
core_signal_oneliner: EMA(12) crosses EMA(36) with ADX(36) > 20 confirming directional microstructure, and price on the VWAP-aligned side
